QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Finding the Songbird
QuestInfo.0: You gave those mean Glimmerfoxes something to think about. Talk to #b#p1501001##k again.
QuestInfo.1: You have to find out what happened to #b#p1501004##k. Head to #b#m101084400##k.

1.msg: (She asks an awful lot of favors...)

2.msg: Please help me out. I hardly ever get visitors, because nobody likes a dark, creepy forest. You're the first person to visit me in ages. Please?

4.msg: Well, the Shimmer Songbird lives in the deepest part of Elodin in a giant tree with a spring.

5.msg: That bird's song always kept the forest calm, but one day, it just stopped.

6.msg: I think that's why everything in the forest is so hostile right now.

7.msg: Something must have happened, but I can't check on it while I'm taking care of this little guy. Plus, everyone's so mad at me that traveling by myself is a terrible idea.

8.msg: Would you be willing to check on the Shimmer Songbird? She might even be able to teach this guy how to sing properly!

0.msg: If you leave here keep going right, deeper into the forest, you'll eventually reach the lair of the Shimmer Songbird!
Are you saying you won't help this poor, sweet, little bird learn to sing, so I can get my beauty sleep?
(What could make such a beautiful bird so sad?)
You'll find the Shimmer Songbird if you go straight to the right of the forest.
